items.desc: The Racket Club welcomes Melbourne’s Eli Gold with a carefully programmed mix that gives the music room to breathe. items.desc: The Racket Club welcomes Birmingham-based DJ Paul BTW back into the clubhouse. Known for exploring the deeper and darker reaches of progressive house through his monthly Mind Therapy Radio show and his exclusive 21C Progressive House series, Discovery, Paul has created a patient, atmospheric mix that captures the sound of the early hours of a club night. The mix develops from deep, hypnotic grooves into a fuller and more driving progressive sound, with music from Gundamea, Marsh, PROFF & Volen Sentir, Gai Barone, Artic White, Jamie Baggotts, EKIS EKIS & Dion Paola and many more.
